To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we developed a video based deep learning architecture for animal pose estimation, which is the first of its kind, and that it is more accurate than current deep learning based pose estimation tools.

we developed a novel animal pose estimation architecture that integrates a flexible base network and optical flow model, which can be combined with multiple view information to enhance prediction accuracy.

we introduce the first deep learning based animal pose estimator, OptiFlex, that can account for variability in body shape and temporal context, and that OptiFlex outperforms current deep learning based pose estimation tools.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an advanced animal pose estimation tool that is applicable across a wide range of animals, which can be used to improve the quality and efficiency of behavioural analysis.

the design, implementation, and evaluation of OptiFlex, a novel video based animal pose prediction framework that is capable of providing accurate predictions on a wide range of animal species and behaviours.
the design of deep neural networks that are more robust to the variability in the shapes of animals and can better handle temporal information from video sequences.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the OptiFlex architecture provides the best accuracy amongst current deep-learning based tools and can be readily applied across a broad range of behaviours.

OptiFlex is a flexible deep learning architecture that can be readily applied for a wide range of animal behaviours, and that it provides the highest accuracy of animal pose estimation amongst current deep learning tools.
our proposed method, OptiFlex, is a powerful tool that can be applied to various behaviours of various animals.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
OptiFlex is a flexible and generalisable video based pose estimator, and that it is a promising tool for the future of animal behaviour quantification.
OptiFlex is an accurate, versatile and easy to implement tool for analysing animal behaviour.
OptiFlex is a novel video based animal pose estimator which provides more accurate predictions than current state of the art tools and can be applied to a wide range of species.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the integration of flexible base models and optical flow models is essential to improve animal pose estimation accuracy.
the integration of flexible base models and temporal information from nearby video frames can greatly improve the accuracy of animal pose estimation.
OptiFlex, a video based animal pose prediction tool that integrates temporal and spatial dimensions of animal pose data, can be used to quantify animal behaviours with high accuracy.
